Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 2.0.0

The skill is a legitimate Nginx configuration generator that produces well-structured configuration snippets for reverse proxies, SSL, static sites, and security hardening. The primary logic in `scripts/nginx.sh` uses standard bash heredocs to output templates based on user-provided arguments without performing any dangerous system operations, network calls, or data exfiltration.

llm.guidance: This appears to be a straightforward nginx config generator. Before running: 1) Inspect the remainder of scripts/nginx.sh (file was truncated in the provided view) to confirm there are no unexpected operations (network calls, file writes, or use of eval/remote downloads). 2) Run the script in a safe environment (non-root) and avoid piping unreviewed scripts to sudo. 3) Be aware it assumes a shell (bash) and references common system paths (e.g. /etc/letsencrypt); providing correct --cert/--domain/--backend values matters. 4) Do not provide secrets or private keys to the tool; if you plan to apply generated configs to production, review them and test in staging first.
